15. LLM Systems

Sangwoo Mo · POSTECH
Industrial & Management Engineering

Where We Are

Part III connects stored data to predictions, answers, and actions

Outline: LLM Systems

The P-17 QuestionWhat is the pressure alarm threshold for P-17?

The answer needs the current P-17 manual

01 · Inputs and Evidence

Large Language ModelsA large language model (LLM) generates text from its input

The input is visible; the generated answer still needs checking

Language Models: A Turning PointIn 2020, GPT-3 showed how task instructions and examples could guide one pretrained model

The input can describe a task without retraining the model for each request

Question Without EvidenceA question alone does not supply the current manual

7 bar is an unsupported example answer

Question With EvidenceThe manual gives the model a source it can use

The supplied P-17 rule states 5 bar

PromptThe prompt is the input sent to the model

Instructions and the question share one input

ContextContext includes the material supplied for this request

The manual text becomes part of the model input

Answer With a SourceA source reference lets a reader inspect the claim

5 bar points back to p17-v4

A Collection of ManualsThe collection contains similar rules for different cases

P-17 has a current rule, an obsolete rule, and a neighbouring pump

02 · Documents and Search

Why Document PreparationThe answer needs the rule and the equipment name together

A value without its row can describe the wrong pump

Loading the ManualLoading extracts readable text from the source

The equipment name, value, and unit survive extraction

Document PiecesA chunk is a small piece that can be retrieved

Each piece keeps a route back to its source

Caveat: Broken ConditionsA cut can separate an instruction from its condition

The stop instruction loses its threshold after a bad cut

Source LabelsA piece keeps its equipment and version alongside the text

The text and its labels travel together

RetrievalRetrieval finds pieces related to the question

A search returns evidence candidates rather than a finished answer

Embeddings: Text Becomes a VectorAn embedding represents text as numbers that can be compared

Related meanings can have similar vectors even when their words differ

Store the Text Beside Its VectorThe stored vector helps find a piece while the text remains the evidence

Keep the original text so the answer can quote or cite its source

Search with the Question VectorEncode the question in the same way, then compare it with stored pieces

The selected vectors lead back to candidate source text

Caveat: Similar but WrongSimilar wording can belong to an obsolete rule

Both P-17 versions mention the same pressure question

Eligible EvidenceOnly approved P-17 sources can support this request

The current rule remains after the equipment and approval checks

Demo: Find the ManualChange the request and approval filter, then inspect the returned source text

Predict which sources will appear, then select Search.

SourceReturned textSimilarity
?Search has not run?

Read the text: does it give the current pressure threshold for this equipment?

Local word-presence search, not a learned embedding or a model answer

Answer: Find the ManualThe baseline returns one pressure rule and one unrelated inspection note

Only p17-v4 answers the pressure threshold question

03 · Answers and Checks

Why Answer ChecksFinding the right source does not force the right answer

The source says 5 bar while the candidate says 7 bar

Evidence in the InputSelected text enters the prompt with its source label

The 5 bar rule reaches the model as p17-v4

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)A 2020 RAG paper connected document retrieval with text generation

Retrieval-augmented generation connects the source to the answer

Checking the EvidenceDoes the selected text answer this question for this equipment?

Current P-17 pressure text supports the requested value

Checking the AnswerDoes the cited text support the value and unit in the answer?

The citation must support the claim beside it

Answer or AbstainMissing evidence calls for an explicit unknown

No supplied document gives the bearing replacement interval

Case study: A Withdrawn ManualA document can disappear while its searchable copy remains

A withdrawn source can still leave searchable pieces

A Small Answer CheckTest the same path with a current, wrong-equipment, and missing-evidence question

One collection exposes the main ways this answer can fail

Takeaway: Answers need evidence that readers can check

1Put the material in the model input
2Retrieve complete pieces from the right current source
3Check the evidence and the answer; say unknown when evidence is missing
